digest.component_or_area: LLM tracing and fallback candidate instrumentation
propositions: Each fallback candidate must emit exactly one ordered child OTel span under the parent Agent model-request span, with no duplication from instrument_all, and nested via ambient OTel context

Each candidate span must record provider-qualified model identity, zero-based order, outcome from {returned, raised}, and optional provider-reported usage, without altering FallbackModel selection or RunUsage
Error reasons on raised candidate spans must be redacted via sanitize_diagnostic under the message key, containing no prompt, response, credential, or endpoint secret

The S2-preserved native-to-prompted downgrade (bug-895c) must be legible as two distinct agent.run spans (native raised, prompted returned) via ambient OTel nesting, with zero change to _pai_structured control flow
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary, leaving fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off
The base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error and identical behavior to tracing-disabled mode
